description: This file defines typography styles for an Android TV frontend using Jetpack Compose. It includes a data class for typography tokens, a default typography configuration with specific font styles, and utility functions for typographic calculations.

classes.name: TvTypography
classes.description: A data class that encapsulates different TextStyle configurations for various UI elements in the app, such as titles, labels, body text, badges, navigation text, and active navigation text.

methods.name: pxToEm
methods.description: Converts pixel-based letter spacing to 'em' units for proper scaling across font sizes.
